Name: Darker Vanilla Forage
Author: deleted116366473
Description:
This mod changes parts of Maps/springobjects to make all vanilla forage in there look darker.

For this purpose I created 3 different shades to choose from.

To choose a shade easily, please use the mod "Generic Mod Config Menu".

If you don't want to use that mod, start your game and exit it again, this will spawn a config.json inside the mod folder for "Darker Vanilla Forage".

Inside Generic Mod Config Menu or the config.json you can choose a number between 1 and 3, the bigger the number gets the darker the forage will become.

The default number is 2.

If you don't like any version of a certain forage you can just disable that specific one and the game will load the vanilla
version of it.



This is the second mod I made, if you want to make your crops look darker too, please visit my other mod "Darker Vanilla Crops".

Manifest.Name: Darker Vanilla Forage
Manifest.Description: Makes vanilla forage a bit darker to fit in with darker recolor mods.
